title: Scaling inequality for the scaled L^p norm on nested closed balls
statement: Let n, ℓ be natural numbers, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} any subset, V a rectifiable n-varifold in U (contract structure RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) with weight μ := V.weight, and H : ℝ^{n+ℓ} → ℝ^{n+ℓ} any function. For p, r real and y a point let K(y, r) := V.scaledLpNorm H p y r = (ofReal(r^{p-n}) · ∫⁻_{B̄_r(y)} ‖H‖ₑ^p dμ)^{1/p} ∈ [0, ∞] (closed balls, lower integral, n read as a real number). If p > 0, 0 < s ≤ t and B̄_s(z) ⊆ B̄_t(w), then K(z, s) ≤ ofReal((s/t)^{(p-n)/p}) · K(w, t).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p : ℝ) (z w : Amb n ℓ) (s t : ℝ), 0 < p → 0 < s → s ≤ t → closedBall z s ⊆ closedBall w t → V.scaledLpNorm H p z s ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((s / t) ^ ((p - n) / p)) * V.scaledLpNorm H p w t
